title: The Borrowed Letter
author: Noor Ravensworth
blurb: Tamsin Kavanagh, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
